AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Due North is an envelope budget (compatible with Actual Budget). Money is given to categories each month; a category's available amount is what is left to spend. Operational patterns: - For 'how much is left for X' call getCategoryBalance; for a general check-in call getBudgetOverview. - Names can be partial and any case. When a call fails because a name fits none or several, ask the user which of the listed names they mean. - addTransaction takes a positive amount; set isIncome for money coming in. Confirm the payee and amount with the user first. - Without a category, a new transaction waits in the inbox, which the user files later in the app. Constraints: - Everything works on the budget open in the app. If no budget is open, tell the user to open Due North first.
